guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice has the strongest anomalies in the digest: memory rose +39.2% (z=+7.85) while its latency-50 dropped 69% (z=-13.84) and CPU fell 34%, which looks like a memory fault, possibly with reduced traffic reaching it. The worst traces show errors only in checkoutservice and frontend, and no logs are available. Checkoutservice calls emailservice, so a failing email call could explain those errors, but the digest does not show it directly.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice memory usage and its recent restarts or deployments, and restart or increase the memory limit on the emailservice pod if a leak is confirmed. Then check whether checkoutservice errors clear.
